Alex Chen: Quick heads-up — after the kernel-selection fallback merged in staging we saw a micro-regression in end-to-end p95 on Llama-13B (c-r1 path). 95p latency up ~18%, token/sec down ~12% on the busy node.
Priya Nair: ugh. Any idea which part — batching, KV cache, or kernel mismatch?
Alex Chen: Initial profiling points to more small batches forming (windowing skew) + higher KV cache miss amplification when fallback switches kernels mid-request. Attaching the queries I used.
Marco Silva: can you paste the queries here? also which rollout ID?
Alex Chen: rollout: canary-ker-sel-v3. Queries (prometheus):
```
sum(rate(redwood_tokens_generated_total[1m])) by (model)
avg(batch_utilization) by (kernel_variant)
(sum(increase(kv_cache_miss_total[5m])) / sum(increase(kv_cache_requests_total[5m])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(batch_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le,kernel_variant))
```
Jenna Park: we only sample 1% of batch traces atm — need to up that to 5% around the canary window. otherwise small-batch tail isn't visible.
Sasha Ilyin: also add a label for `kernel_switch=true/false` on requests so we can break out latencies for mid-request kernel switches.
Priya Nair: agree. For dashboards: panels for batch_size distribution (count and 90/99), queue_depth over time, token/sec, kv_cache_hit_rate, and a panel correlating kernel_variant vs p95. Add alert when average batch_utilization < 0.6 and queue_depth > 50s.
Alex Chen: noted. I'll add the kernel_switch tag in the runtime and bump trace sampling to 5% for the canary window. Can someone update the dashboard? Prefer a compact panel on the runtime perf board.
Marco Silva: I'll add the panels. Suggest using a streaming sparkline for token/sec and an overlay for kv_cache_miss_rate.
deploy-bot: [deploy] canary-ker-sel-v3 started by @alex on prod/staging at 2026-03-18T15:06:12Z :rocket:
Jenna Park: after we get the extra telemetry, plan: 1) validate if kernel switch correlates with KV miss increase 2) if yes, land a debounce window for kernel fallback 3) run a 2-hour sustained load test with synthetic token distribution.
Priya Nair: also, add a metric for `prefetch_kvcache_hit` vs `on_demand_kvcache_hit` — might explain extra round trips.
Alex Chen: will do. Thanks team. I'll post follow-up with graphs in ~30m.
Sasha Ilyin: fyi, I saw a subtle change in the kernel selection scores yesterday; I'll dump the scoring histogram to the slack thread when ready.
Marco Silva: cool. tagging @Jenna to coordinate dashboard UX.
Jenna Park: on it. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: thanks — keeping this thread as the source of truth for canary telemetry.
